answers.workaround:
You could manually fix dependencies, ensure if paths have collisions etc, which is not handy.

I also see the following partial solution: you could have a script, plugin, or other built-in (Godot) or third-party tool that copies a scene from one project to another, but sets the correct paths for the scene dependencies (that is changes the tscn file); you just select the target project and target folder where you want to copy the scene; but
- in fact, the user depends on such a script/plugin/tool; that is, the user has to use that tool (while he could just use dependency paths relative to the scene, which would be more self-sufficient imo).
- I do not exclude pitfalls here

title: Add an option to save scene dependencies paths as relative to the scene
